title: NameGen: one display-name PDA per wallet
summary: Init a user PDA, set a 64-byte UTF-8 name, clear it, and see why another wallet cannot edit your account.
what: Each wallet has one NameGen PDA, seeded ["user", authority]. Init creates it, set_name writes a 64-byte UTF-8 name, clear_name zeros it, and a second wallet cannot change someone else's PDA because the seeds include the signer.
app_note: The fork's own Next.js 14 app (web/) exported as static pages with this devnet program ID. Changes: static export with basePath; getPda/getProgram read the program id from the IDL; Read decodes the name from the 8+32+64 account layout (BorshCoder.accounts.decode("UserData") did not return .name in this IDL).

try_steps.do: Open [NameGen](/dapps/c4-comets-todor-edward-andrei/) and connect a Phantom wallet set to **devnet**.
try_steps.see: The app shows your wallet. If you have never initialised, the user PDA does not exist yet.

try_steps.do: Run **init** for your wallet (create the NameGen PDA seeded `["user", authority]`). Approve.
try_steps.see: A successful `init_user` transaction. The PDA now exists for your authority.
ran: Script: B already funded 0.03 SOL (no transfer resent)

try_steps.do: Set a display name (up to 64 UTF-8 bytes). Approve.
try_steps.see: A `set_name` transaction. The account stores your name bytes.
ran: Script: A inits user PDA ["user", A]

try_steps.do: Clear the name, then set a different one.
try_steps.see: `clear_name` zeros the name field; a later `set_name` writes the new bytes.

try_steps.do: Optional: from a second wallet, try to change the first wallet’s PDA.
try_steps.see: The transaction fails at account constraints (`ConstraintSeeds` before any `NotOwner` branch). Your PDA stays unchanged.

diagram:
wallet A ─ init_user ─▶ UserData PDA seeds=["user", authority]
wallet A ─ set_name([u8;64]) ─▶ same PDA
wallet A ─ clear_name ─▶ same PDA (name zeros)
wallet B ─ set_name on A’s PDA ─▶ ConstraintSeeds (wrong seeds for B)
accounts: Pays rent on init; must match the PDA seeds

instructions.name: `init_user`: create the display-name account
steps: Seeds are `["user", authority.key()]`. One PDA per wallet.
Init fails if the account already exists.

instructions.name: `set_name` / `clear_name`
steps: A second wallet cannot satisfy the PDA seeds for someone else’s authority, so the constraint fails first.

innovation.text: A minimal profile registry: one PDA per wallet, fixed-size name bytes, no token vault.

frontend.title: Connect and derive the user PDA
steps: The client derives the user account from seeds `["user", wallet]` and the program id before sending `init_user` or `set_name`.
Only the matching wallet can sign instructions that list that PDA under those seeds.

exercises.title: Read the PDA seeds on Explorer
steps: Open the init signature under Proof.
Confirm the program id and that the user account is owned by the NameGen program.
exercises.expect: Program ERvcD84tLcdeYgb4RM7WhJLBFDmous4D6uk32GSEnjPG is invoked and the user PDA is created.

exercises.title: Explain the failed foreign write
steps: Open the foreign-wallet failure signature if listed under Proof.
exercises.expect: ConstraintSeeds (or equivalent), not a successful overwrite.

not_covered: No ENS-style secondary market; no UTF-8 validation beyond fitting 64 bytes; the redundant NotOwner branch is noted in the deployment limits because seeds already bind the account.
objectives: Write and clear a fixed-size name field
See why another wallet cannot edit your PDA
prereqs: A Solana address is not always a wallet
